contentPattern.structure: cover image + breadcrumb + headline + byline + date/read-time + category tag

suitableFor: blog / article detail page title headers
editorial headers pairing a cover image with breadcrumb, byline, publish date, read time and a category tag
long-form content page intros with no CTA buttons
notSuitableFor: landing-page intros with dual CTAs and an image cluster (use hero-intro)
dark full-bleed background-image CTA banners (use hero-banner)
